fullDescription.text: A component implemented more than once. An agent asked for it has several plausible answers.
Defined in the system, imported by nothing. It sits there as a wrong answer waiting to be picked.
Static values written as style attributes, bypassing the system and teaching the agent to do the same.
Forces a style through instead of fixing the rule that blocked it. Fix specificity at the source and these stop being necessary.
Colour values no token names. Each one is a value the agent will happily copy.
The agent rules reference something this scan can no longer find. A rule the agent obeys is worse than no rule when the repo has moved on.
